description: Static review for right-to-left languages. Pass `source` as HTML with styles, or CSS. Lists margin, padding, border, left, right, float, clear, text-align, border-radius corner and translateX declarations with the logical replacement (margin-inline-start, inset-inline-end, text-align: start and so on), flags letter-spacing and italic on Arabic, justified Arabic, bidi overrides and embedded control characters, missing html lang and dir, free-text inputs without dir="auto", phone-like strings that need <bdi>, and directional icons by name (arrows, chevrons, back, next, reply, send) that usually mirror versus ones that do not (play, search, check, logos). Icon advice is by name and follows common guidance, so treat it as convention. Reads the pasted source only; nothing is rendered or run, stored or logged.
